methodology_name: Soil Organic Carbon Estimation in Regenerative Cropping and Managed Grassland Ecosystems
protocol: GHG Benefits in Managed Crop and Grassland Systems
checklist_template_source: [Template] V2 Project Registration Registry Agent Review- C06 Ecometric.docx (Becca, 2026-04-28)

requirements.requirement_text: Projects shall apply the latest version of the applicable credit class and methodology
requirements.accepted_evidence: Project plan, methodology and credit class version are up to date

requirements.requirement_text: Submit a Project Plan that defines and evidences the Project Area(s), Project Activity, Project Eligibility, and Project Rules and Regulations
requirements.accepted_evidence: Completed Project Plan template containing all required sections and supporting information

requirements.requirement_text: Ecosystem Type(s) must be categorized as croplands, grasslands, pastureland, and shrubland as defined in the RND Taxonomy. For Aggregate Projects, each site must demonstrate compliance with this requirement
requirements.accepted_evidence: Description within the Project Plan supported by available datasets (e.g. soil maps, climate zone classification, land-use/land-cover data)

requirements.requirement_text: Provide evidence of legal land tenure and control over the project area during the crediting period. In the case of leased land this must include landowner approval. For Aggregate Projects, each site must demonstrate compliance with this requirement
requirements.source: Program Guide, Section 8.2; Credit Class, Section 3.4, 3.5
requirements.accepted_evidence: Deeds, lease agreements, land use agreements, or legal attestations confirming long-term control and ownership, such as National or regional agricultural land registries (e.g. LPIS, PPA or equivalent)

requirements.requirement_text: Demonstrate the property was not converted from natural ecosystems in the 10 years before the project start date. For Aggregate Projects, each site must demonstrate compliance with this requirement
requirements.source: Program Guide, Section 8.3.1; Methodology; Credit Class, Section 3.1
requirements.accepted_evidence: Satellite imagery analysis (e.g. Sentinel, Google Earth historical imagery), land-use or land-cover datasets, national agricultural land registries (e.g. LPIS, PPA), farm management records, legal documentation, or similarly rigorous and verifiable evidence demonstrating land-use history

requirements.requirement_text: Clearly define geographic boundaries of the project area with clear demarcation of areas eligible or ineligible for credit issuance
requirements.accepted_evidence: GIS shapefiles and maps, with delineations of eligible and ineligible land

requirements.requirement_text: State that the project is an Aggregate Project and justify registration of the aggregated project in the Project Plan
requirements.accepted_evidence: Project Plan description stating that the project is an Aggregate Project and providing justification for the grouped project structure

requirements.requirement_text: State the bioregion and, if appropriate, national boundary basis of the aggregation
requirements.accepted_evidence: Project Plan description of the aggregation basis including the bioregion and, where applicable, national boundary

requirements.requirement_text: Demonstrate that grouped Sites are in the same pre-defined climatic or geographic region and are as homogeneous as possible in soil, ecology, and land management practice
requirements.source: Program Guide, Section 8.10.1; Credit Class, Section 4.2
requirements.accepted_evidence: Project Plan description of grouping criteria and homogeneity rationale supported by Site-level location, ecological, soil, and land management information

requirements.requirement_text: Ensure all Sites remain individually identifiable within the aggregate project
requirements.accepted_evidence: Project Plan or supplementary documentation showing each Site has a unique identifier and can be separately traced within the aggregate

requirements.requirement_text: Ensure all Sites are subject to standard monitoring requirements, with no extrapolation between Sites
requirements.accepted_evidence: Project Plan or monitoring design showing that each Site is treated as individually subject to standard monitoring requirements and that no extrapolation is applied between Sites

requirements.requirement_text: Describe the project boundary, including relevant GHG sinks, sources, reservoirs, and other relevant ecological indicators (if applicable)
requirements.accepted_evidence: Project Plan section describing relevant GHG sinks, sources, reservoirs, and relevant indicators

requirements.requirement_text: The project proponent must stipulate the ownership of credits and how they are distributed among stakeholders
requirements.accepted_evidence: Document of credit ownership structure requirement in Project Plan or reference contracts

requirements.requirement_text: Project must stipulate the Project Start Date and justify how it meets the eligibility requirements. If the Project Start Date precedes registration, justify how eligibility and required data conditions were met before registration. The Project Proponent must demonstrate clear historical records to that effect and justify how eligibility requirements are met. For aggregated projects, Project Start Date may vary by site. Individual sites must define their own Project Start Date
requirements.source: Program Guide, Section 8.6; Credit Class, Section 3.7
requirements.accepted_evidence: Explicit definition of the Project Start Date in the Project Plan

requirements.requirement_text: Stipulate the Crediting Period in the Project Plan. For this Credit Class the Crediting Period is 10 years, with the option to renew. In aggregated projects, sites may vary in their crediting period. Sites added after the project registration date must maintain a 10 year crediting period. Individual sites must define their own Crediting Period
requirements.source: Program Guide, Section 8.7.2; Credit Class, Section 3.7
requirements.accepted_evidence: Explicit definition of the Crediting Period in the Project Plan

requirements.requirement_text: Legally required practices are not accepted. For Aggregate Projects, each site must document proof of compliance with the requirement
requirements.accepted_evidence: Regulatory analysis, legal or policy review, applicable law or program requirement records, Project Plan justification showing the activity is not legally required, and site-level documentation confirming the same for each Site

requirements.requirement_text: Demonstrate the project activity results in carbon storage above business as usual. For Aggregate Projects, each site must document proof of compliance with the requirement
requirements.accepted_evidence: Baseline or business-as-usual comparison, modeled or measured carbon outcomes, management practice comparison, and site-level records demonstrating carbon storage above business as usual for each Site

requirements.requirement_text: Demonstrate the project activity has a reasonable expectation for carbon dioxide drawdown. For Aggregate Projects, each site must document proof of compliance with the requirement
requirements.accepted_evidence: Project Plan justification, scientific literature, methodology-based quantification approach, modeled or measured carbon sequestration estimates, and site-level evidence showing a reasonable expectation of carbon dioxide draw down for each Site

requirements.requirement_text: Report 5-year rolling average yield at registration and each monitoring round. Any reduction in monitoring-period yield greater than 10% relative to the 5-year rolling average, or 10% or more below the regional average for that crop type where climatic conditions reduce regional yield, must be reported as leakage. For Aggregate Projects, each site must report its 5-year rolling average and document any reductions above 10%
requirements.accepted_evidence: Historic yield records for the 5-year rolling average, registration and monitoring-round yield records, annual project reports, regional yield comparison data where applicable, leakage calculations, and site-level yield documentation for each Site

requirements.requirement_text: Projects must maintain the same land use during the Project Period. For Aggregate Projects, Project Periods might vary between sites. Each site must demonstrate maintained land use during its own Project Period
requirements.accepted_evidence: Project Plan land-use description, land-use or land-cover records, satellite imagery, farm management records, field histories, and site-level documentation demonstrating maintained land use throughout each Site's Project Period

requirements.requirement_text: The project shall have a 10-year permanence period. For Aggregate Projects, Project Periods might vary between sites. Each site must demonstrate maintained land use during its own Permanence Period
requirements.accepted_evidence: Explicit permanence period duration in the Project Plan

requirements.requirement_text: Provide attestation of regulatory compliance demonstrating the project is materially compliant to all laws, regulations, and other legally binding mandates directly related to project activities. For Aggregate Projects, each site must demonstrate compliance with this requirement
requirements.accepted_evidence: Documentation of all relevant laws, regulations, or other legally binding mandates directly related to Project Activities and indications of where Project Activities violate compliance

requirements.requirement_text: Project Proponents must disclose if they have applied, been listed, registered, or issued credits under another registry, or if they have known plans to apply in the future. For Aggregate Projects, each site must demonstrate compliance with this requirement
requirements.accepted_evidence: Official documentation from other registries detailing the project status, issued credits, or correspondence regarding approvals or rejections. If no prior or parallel registration exists, a clear disclosure statement or attestation in the Project Plan is sufficient

requirements.requirement_text: No Net Harm: detail any potential negative socio-economic and environmental impacts of the project and the steps taken to mitigate them
requirements.accepted_evidence: Documentation of conflict resolution, mitigation plans, grievance redresses. This section may reference the same Project Plan content used to demonstrate safeguards, where applicable

requirements.requirement_text: Local Stakeholder Consultation: Project Proponent must indicate how local stakeholders were identified and consulted prior to project implementation
requirements.accepted_evidence: Descriptions in Project Plan, consultation documentation

requirements.requirement_text: Environmental Impact: Project Proponent must indicate if environmental impact assessments were undertaken and describe the process and findings
requirements.accepted_evidence: Environmental impact reports and statements

requirements.requirement_text: Public comment: Specify if community public consultation was undertaken during the project implementation and how comments were addressed
requirements.accepted_evidence: Statements and documentation from public consultation process

requirements.requirement_text: Project Plan deviations must provide evidence that the proposed deviation meets the conservativeness standards of the Credit Protocol
requirements.accepted_evidence: Statement in the Project Plan of proposed deviation

requirements.requirement_text: Demonstrate the project activity meets the approved activities for the credit class: regenerative crop management or managed grazing. Records detailing 5-years of historic project activity, which may include but is not limited to, cultivation types, drilling types, crop types, average annual yield per crop type and crop residue handling. For Aggregate Projects, each site must demonstrate compliance with this requirement
requirements.accepted_evidence: Records detailing 5-years of historic project activity, which may include but is not limited to, cultivation types, drilling types, crop types, average annual yield per crop type and crop residue handling

requirements.requirement_text: Provide a detailed plan for ongoing monitoring, including indicators, methods, and responsibilities
requirements.accepted_evidence: Monitoring schedules, soil sampling protocols, remote sensing details, and monitoring responsibility assignments
